hero.heading: A Whole New Vibe for AI
hero.sub: In Hawaiian culture, the honu (green sea turtle) is a symbol of wisdom, endurance, and safe passage through unknown waters. HonuVibe carries that spirit — guiding curious minds through the vast ocean of AI with patience, purpose, and aloha.

mission.heading: Mission & Vision
mission.description: The honu navigates thousands of miles across open ocean, always finding its way home. We believe that same quiet determination lives in every builder and entrepreneur reaching for something new. HonuVibe exists to be the current that carries them forward — bridging Hawaii and Japan to make cutting-edge AI accessible to everyone.
mission.mission_text: To make cutting-edge AI education approachable, actionable, and community-driven — for Hawaii's local business community, ambitious entrepreneurs across the US, and Japanese learners eager to access emerging AI technologies from the source. Like the honu, we move with intention: steady progress over hype, real skills over shortcuts.
mission.vision_text: A world where every entrepreneur, regardless of technical background or geography, has the tools and community they need to build with AI. The honu thrives because it belongs to both land and sea — and HonuVibe thrives at the intersection of cultures, from Waikiki to Tokyo, creating a new standard for practitioner-focused education.

aloha_standard.sub: Aloha is not a marketing tagline — it is the actual operating standard for how HonuVibe shows up in every interaction.

founder.heading: Ryan Jackson
founder.bio_p1: Ryan is the founder of HonuVibe.AI and brings a unique combination of business strategy, international market experience, and hands-on AI expertise. With deep roots in both the California entrepreneurial ecosystem and the Japanese business community, Ryan bridges the gap between American AI innovation and the needs of international professionals.
founder.bio_p2: Ryan works daily with the latest AI platforms — Claude, ChatGPT, and a wide range of professional AI tools — and brings that practitioner experience directly into the classroom. His teaching style is hands-on and jargon-free: every session is built around doing, not just watching.
founder.bio_p3: As a leader in the AI education space, Ryan is actively involved in the entrepreneurial, AI, and venture capital communities across Hawaii and California — bringing real-world insights on how AI is transforming American businesses into every lesson.

privacy_page.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: HonuVibe.AI ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you voluntarily provide when you register, make a purchase, subscribe to our newsletter, fill out a form, or contact us. This may include your name, email address, billing information, and any other information you choose to provide.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the information we collect to provide and maintain our services, process transactions, send communications about courses and events, improve our website and user experience, and comply with legal obligations.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and services (such as payment processors, email providers, and analytics services), subject to confidentiality agreements.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings. For more information, see our Cookie Notice.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of marketing communications at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@honuvibe.ai.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on our website with a new effective date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@honuvibe.ai.

terms_page.heading: Terms of Service
terms_page.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of HonuVibe.AI website and services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms.

use.title: Use of Services
use.content: You may use our services for lawful purposes only. You agree not to misuse our services, interfere with their operation, or attempt to access them using unauthorized methods.

accounts.title: Accounts

cookies_page.heading: Cookie Notice
cookies_page.intro: This Cookie Notice explains how HonuVibe.AI uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.

what.title: What Are Cookies?
what.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your experience.

types.title: Types of Cookies We Use
types.content: Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly (authentication, security, language preferences). Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors use our site (Plausible Analytics — privacy-focused, no personal data collected). Preference Cookies: Remember your settings such as theme preference (dark/light mode) and language selection.

third_party.title: Third-Party Cookies
third_party.content: We use minimal third-party services. Plausible Analytics does not use cookies and respects Do Not Track. Payment processing through Stripe may set cookies required for transaction security.

control.title: Managing Cookies
control.content: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies.

changes.title: Changes to This Notice
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Notice as our practices change. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised date.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: Questions about our cookie practices? Contact us at privacy@honuvibe.ai.

instructors.ryan_bio: Founder of HonuVibe.AI. Uniquely combines business strategy, international market experience, and practical AI expertise. With deep roots in both the California entrepreneurial ecosystem and the Japanese business community, he acts as a bridge connecting American AI innovation with the needs of international professionals. Using Claude, ChatGPT, and a wide array of AI tools daily in his work, he actively participates in the AI, venture capital, and entrepreneurial communities across Hawaii and California. His teaching style is practical and easy to understand, with every session centered around 'learning by doing'.
instructors.ryan_education_1: MBA (International Business) — USC Marshall School of Business
instructors.mizuho_bio: Brings extensive corporate business experience and a native Japanese perspective. As Lead AI Trainer, she translates cutting-edge AI concepts into practical, culturally relevant applications, ensuring every lesson aligns with the real-world needs of Japanese professionals. Through her corporate operations background, she deeply understands the workflows and organizational dynamics Japanese professionals face daily. Working alongside Ryan, she helps deliver a truly bilingual learning experience.
instructors.chimi_bio: Uniquely combines healthcare expertise, business operations, and AI consulting. As a certified Occupational Therapist, she understands how people learn and integrate new tools into their work, making her uniquely effective as an AI Trainer. She applies her practical experience in implementing new systems and processes into organizations to AI education. Together with Ryan and Mizuho, she provides hands-on support to every student. Her careful, detailed approach is particularly popular among AI beginners.

questions.headline: Questions
questions.q_1_q: What's the smallest project you take?
questions.q_1_a: Most engagements start at 4 weeks / ~$20K USD. We occasionally take 2-week sprints for existing clients or pro-bono work.
questions.q_2_q: Are you locked into a specific stack?
questions.q_2_a: We default to Next.js + Tailwind + Supabase + Vercel because it ships fast and stays maintainable. We'll happily work in your stack if you have one.
questions.q_3_a: Claude and Cursor are first-class tools in our build process — not bolt-ons. We design prompts, libraries, and review loops the way a senior engineer designs functions. The result: more shipped, less typed.
questions.q_4_a: Yes — fully. Code, designs, content, and accounts transfer to you at handoff. We retain no exclusive rights.
questions.q_5_q: How do you handle Japanese localization?
questions.q_5_a: Bilingual EN/JP is core to how HonuVibe operates. Every project can ship with JP-native typography, layout, and copy reviewed by a native speaker — not machine translation.

meta.title: About — People first. Always. | HonuVibe
meta.description: HonuVibe.AI is an AI training and consulting company built on a simple belief: everyone deserves access to practical AI education — delivered with genuine care, in the language they think in.

hero.lede: For entrepreneurs, professionals, and organizations across the US and Japan.

origin_story.p1: HonuVibe started with a question: what would happen if AI education felt less like a tech bootcamp and more like learning from someone who actually cares whether you succeed?
origin_story.p2: Ryan Jackson — Northwestern grad, USC Marshall MBA, and lifelong builder — had spent years at the intersection of business strategy, international markets, and hands-on AI work. He saw the same pattern everywhere: people were curious about AI but overwhelmed by the noise. The courses were too technical, too theoretical, or too impersonal.
origin_story.p3: So he built HonuVibe — a training company grounded in showing up fully, giving generously, and treating every person's goals as worthy of real attention. Today, HonuVibe serves learners and organizations globally, in English and Japanese, with a growing team of practitioners who teach what they actually do.

team.subhead: Every HonuVibe instructor is a working practitioner — not an academic, not a script reader.
team.members_ryan_bio: Ryan brings a unique combination of business strategy, international market experience, and hands-on AI expertise. His teaching style is hands-on and jargon-free — every session is built around doing, not just watching.
team.members_mizuho_bio: Mizuho brings a corporate business background and native Japanese fluency to HonuVibe's bilingual programs. She bridges the gap between American AI innovation and the practical needs of Japanese professionals.
team.members_chimi_bio: Chiemi is a Certified Occupational Therapist with deep business operations experience. She brings a unique perspective on how AI can improve workflows in healthcare, professional services, and community organizations.

aloha_standard.lede: Aloha is not a marketing tagline. It is the actual operating standard for how HonuVibe shows up — in every course, every partnership, and every interaction.
aloha_standard.generously_body: Free content, free community access, transparent information. We trust that generosity compounds.
aloha_standard.no_hard_sell_body: We invite. We demonstrate. We let the quality of the work speak. People who are right for HonuVibe will feel it.
aloha_standard.pro_bono_body: When a nonprofit or community organization comes to us, they receive the same quality and attention as any paying client. Their mission matters.
aloha_standard.celebrate_body: When a HonuVibe member ships a project, grows their business, or wins a grant — that is a HonuVibe moment. We make space for those stories.

meta.title: Partnerships — HonuVibe.AI
meta.description: Three ways to work with HonuVibe — bilingual cohort programs, at-cost project builds, and senior AI strategy. Hawaii-rooted, Japan-fluent.

editorial_hero.lede: HonuVibe partners three ways. We teach for your community, we build with your team, and we advise where it matters most. Senior team. At-cost work. Hawaii-rooted.

cohort.lede: Always-on learning communities co-designed with your team — the curriculum, the community space, and the cohort cycles your members will actually return to. We bring the platform and the instruction; you bring the people. Bilingual delivery available when you need it.
cohort.outcome_curriculum_body: Designed around your members' skill level, industry, and goals — not a generic syllabus.
cohort.outcome_cobranded_body: Your brand, your community, our infrastructure and instruction. Live sessions, recordings, and Vault access.
cohort.outcome_revenue_body: Flexible revenue models — share of program revenue, flat license, or sponsor-funded. We size the model to your community and goals during discovery.
cohort.quote: We didn't want a syllabus that had been used somewhere else first. HonuVibe built the program for our members — and our members can tell the difference.
cohort.proof_program: A founding-member cohort taught in two communities. Five-week program covering AI Essentials and AI Mastery, run live on Zoom with permanent Vault access. Bilingual delivery throughout — because this community needed it.
cohort.also_value: A bilingual healthcare archive · A photography collective rebuild · TBD with Ryan

project.lede: When a community needs more than a course — when they need the app, the archive, the dashboard, the bilingual site — we ship it. Senior team, scoped sprints, fixed-fee or hourly. No agency markup, no offshore handoff.
project.outcome_production_body: Shipped on your stack and your domain. Real users, real data, real launch.
project.outcome_handoff_body: Your team can run it. Code, infra, runbooks, and the calls to prove it.
project.outcome_retainer_body: Keep us for ongoing iteration, AI tooling work, and bilingual content support.
project.quote: You get a small, senior team that ships weekly demos, learns from a real codebase, and writes down how we worked with AI so your team can keep going.
project.tile_a_body: Internal AI-first reference platform for a Tokyo-based medical group.
project.tile_b_body: Editorial-grade archive site with AI-assisted captioning and search.
project.tile_c_body: We take on a small number of new builds each quarter. Tell us yours.

consulting.lede: When you need someone senior in the room before you commit headcount or vendors. We run AI-readiness audits, pick the tools, design the workflows, and train your team to keep going after we leave. The deliverable is a roadmap your people will actually open again.
consulting.outcome_audit_body: Where AI fits, where it doesn't, what to do first, what to wait on. Written down.
consulting.outcome_workflow_body: Concrete tools, concrete prompts, concrete adoption plan — not vendor decks.
consulting.outcome_enablement_body: Workshops and writeups so your team can keep going without us.
consulting.quote: Often the cheapest move at a 40-person team can made it to write down how it already and AI — and then make that handbook actually good.
consulting.artifact_caption: A studio AI handbook that paid for itself in one quarter.

method.headline: Method
method.footnote: Same operating system. Three different shapes.
method.row_discover_cohort: 1–2 weeks. Surveys, member interviews, language preferences.
method.row_discover_project: At kickoff. Scoped to the product surface and users.
method.row_discover_consulting: One-day intensive. Stakeholders in one room.
method.row_design_cohort: 2–3 weeks. Modules outlined, recordings planned, instructors briefed.
method.row_design_project: Sprint + signed SOW. Tight surface, fixed fee where possible.
method.row_design_consulting: Roadmap doc. The thing you'll re-open every quarter.
method.row_ship_cohort: 6–12 week live cohort. Bilingual delivery, async on Vault.
method.row_ship_project: 1–6+ week build. Weekly demos. Production launch.
method.row_ship_consulting: Workshops, working sessions, decisions on the record.
method.row_iterate_cohort: Live cohort sessions. Office hours. Vault open after.
method.row_iterate_project: Handoff + optional retainer. Your team owns the keys.
method.row_iterate_consulting: Written artifacts. Team enablement until they don't need us.
method.row_outcome_cohort: Cohort engagement, completion, and a bilingual Vault library.
method.row_outcome_project: A production launch your team can run.
method.row_outcome_consulting: An aligned plan and a team that can execute it.

feature_case.brief_headline: A bilingual cohort, made for Vertice members.
feature_case.brief_body: Vertice came to us with a community of Tokyo-based professionals who needed practical AI training in both English and Japanese. We co-designed a five-week cohort — curriculum, language strategy, Vault library, and certificate — that runs under both brands and lives in both communities.
feature_case.make_dashboard_caption: Bilingual LMS · weekly progress · session replays
feature_case.make_slide_caption: Side-by-side EN / 日本語 · Vertice + HonuVibe lockup
feature_case.make_session_caption: Zoom · 36 min avg · breakout pods in both languages
feature_case.stat_size_caption: Two cohorts to date · third in planning
feature_case.quote_partner: It felt less like buying a course and more like co-launching a flagship program under our brand — but built on infrastructure we could never have built alone.
feature_case.quote_ryan: Vertice gave us the community, the language nuance, and the trust. We brought the curriculum, the platform, and the bilingual instruction. Neither of us could have shipped this alone — and that's the point.

programs.lede: Curriculum and delivery co-designed with your community lead — and a revenue model that helps your community monetize the knowledge. We bring the instruction and the platform; you bring the people and the voice.

products.lede: Senior product team alongside yours. Weekly demos. We hand over the keys, the docs, and the calls to prove your team can run it after we leave.

plans.lede: Senior strategy alongside your leadership. AI-readiness audits, tool selection, workflow design, and the team enablement that makes the plan actually run.

duet_quotes.headline: What we've said to each other

1.partner: I thought we'd hire a vendor. We ended up with a co-founder for this program. They treat our community like it's theirs too.
1.ryan: It is ours too. When a cohort doesn't work, that's our failure. When it does, the partner gets the win. That trade is the whole point.

2.partner: The bilingual delivery isn't a translation pass. It's a different kind of teaching — and they know the difference.
2.ryan: Translating slides isn't bilingual. We rewrite the example, the pacing, sometimes the whole module. Japanese-first when the audience is Japanese-first.

3.partner: I keep thinking we're going to outgrow this. We haven't. We've just grown into it together.
3.ryan: We don't aim to be a vendor you can replace. We aim to be the partner you'd start a new program with — and that's what we keep doing.
